## Checklist

- [ ] PR title, branch name and every commit message follow CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] New logic has tests (bug fixes include a test that failed before the fix)
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files or debug code committed
- [ ] Story files validate (if story content changed)
- [ ] Prisma migration included and tested (if the database schema changed)
- [ ] Docs updated (if behavior or setup changed)
